_about: Inputs of cloud/cost.mjs: the inputs of sandbox/cost.mjs, with the numbers of the cloud design. measured = runs of 2026-11-12 through agentd in Docker at 1/2 vCPU (cloud/COST.md). assumed = a deploy must replace it (cloud/measure-after-deploy.mjs).

included._source: Workers Paid, each month: 25 GiB-hours of memory, 375 vCPU-minutes, 200 GB-hours of disk, 400,000 GB-s and 1 million requests of Durable Objects, 1 million class A and 10 million class B R2 operations, 10 million Worker requests

engine._measured: Claude Code 2.1.311, sonnet, agentd in the cloud image, 1/2 vCPU and 4 GiB (standard-1), 2026-11-12. cold_busy_s: job to the end of the program on a new container (8.65 s, 1 run). warm_busy_s: the same with a program that waits (4.45, 4.75, 4.46 s; 3 runs).

engine_at._measured: Claude Code 2.1.311, sonnet, docker mode, SANDBOX_CPUS=0.25, 2026-11-12: a program that waited 50 s still took 12.4 s from the job to its end, and the cgroup counted 3.6 vCPU-s for its start and 3.6 for the run (0.7 to 1.0 at 1/2 or 2 vCPU).

codex._measured: Codex 0.167.2. Busy: 10.4 to 13.8 s from the start to the end of codex exec with the real model (host mode, 4 runs). CPU: the stand-in model run in the image took 0.16 to 0.25 vCPU-s at 1/4 vCPU and 0.21 at 2 vCPU with a warm page cache (codex-standin.mjs). No program waits, so a Codex container uses no CPU between runs.

cloud._assumed: start_s: Cloudflare says cold starts are often 1 to 3 s; agentd adds its own start (1.0 to 1.95 s from docker run to /health locally, measured). restore_s: R2 get (assumed 0.1 s) plus the unpack (9 ms, measured). save_s: pack and seal of the 118 KB archive (0.57 s measured, with the start of a container) plus R2 put (assumed). do_requests_per_run: counted in the design (see COST.md). worker_requests_per_run: the calls of the outbound handler, one for each request of agentd.
